rows.notes: Phase 2G-mini (2026-07-27): added spec intro/disclaimer sentence to the rendered accommodation table (pdf_generator_service.dart). Table itself kept as real, useful structured data - spec's simple floor-list framing added as an intro line, not a replacement.

Phase 2A covered the main activity_property_local_environment screen (flooding/EMF). Phase 2G-mini (2026-07-27) migrated the other 2 screens spec's checklist maps to: activity_property_is_noisy_area (busy road/rail/airport/motorway) and activity_risks_other_ (the tree's "J4 Other" screen - its real spec home is here, not Section J). Commercial premises/Industrial premises/Public house/School checklist items still have no field anywhere - open gap for the product-decisions doc.

rows.notes: Phase 2B closed content. Phase 2G-mini (2026-07-27) fixed a duplicate-screen bug: activity_outside_property_other_joinery_finishes_condition's numeric 1/2/3 field was routed to the descriptive condition handler, producing "appear in 1 condition" nonsense - now routed to the correct numeric-rating handler. The underlying duplicate-screen redundancy (two screens for one rating concept) remains an open product question.

~20 of spec's ~26 named sub-topics (Electrical/Gas/Heating records, Renewable Energy, Damp-Proofing, Timber Treatment, Asbestos, Flood Risk, Trees, Rights of Way, Shared Facilities, Private Roads, Leasehold/Freehold specifics, General Legal Enquiries, etc.) have no matching field anywhere in I1-I3. Mapped/existing content (I1 Regulation, I2 Guarantees, I3 Other Matters) is migrated to L2 wording. Largest content-gap cluster of the whole migration - flagged for a dedicated product conversation.
